hypothesis: The old sentence representation cannot distinguish internal word permutations with identical endpoints/bags. Seven ordered regions and distant before/after token groups remove that specific information loss without new parameter matrices. Public improvement is not presumed.
representation: AXSQ0009 explicitly persists ordered regions and distant relative context; legacy AXSQ0006/AXSQ0007 default remains unchanged. Each region is still an unordered set; this is not recurrence, full token order, sense disambiguation or a new intelligence paradigm.
comparison: Paired window/regions policies share RNG, parameter shapes, vocabulary selection and quotas. Changed groups also change effective normalization/dropout activation; do not attribute outcomes only to word order. Policy 0 must reproduce lexical-encoder-v3 policy 2 learned-page bytes and 1504 prediction rows. The inherited operational parent is the newer winner/context seed, so whole-genome identity with the older parent is not expected; verify preservation of this current parent separately.
selection: Same existing development exact frame count, then parameter count, then index. Score every fixed policy including regressions. No test or reserved-worker evaluation.
limits: 196608-byte page, 262144-byte genome, 64 input words, demand-loaded model, no teacher labels at inference, measured scoring including refusals. Whole-process RSS and energy unavailable.
scope: Consumed public development data, not independent new semantic acceptance. No automatic WordNet synonyms, external pretrained knowledge, general conversation, tool permission, full M1 or M2 promotion.
